Message:
kvm: x86: fix comment about {mmu,nested_mmu}.gva_to_gpa

The comment had the meaning of mmu.gva_to_gpa and nested_mmu.gva_to_gpa
swapped. Fix that, and also add some details describing how each translation
works.
